fields.acceptance: go test ./internal/api -run 'TestHealthMainOrphanLog' asserts an orphan entry makes the main part bad with the entry, change set and command named, and an entry held by a model branch or a live run leaves the part ok with the pending entry listed
fields.statement: rhiza health's main-checkout part reports each untracked .rhiza/log entry that no pending model branch or live run holds as a problem (bad, exit 1, shown in rhiza health and the daemon status), naming the entry, its change set and rhiza model commit-untracked; an entry a pending model branch holds is listed as pending, not a problem
